shared_transport_fraction.definition: existing providers whose send path uses the shared postJson HTTP helper

vector.payload_basis: Slack attachments, Discord embeds, Telegram chat/text/parse-mode and ntfy topic/title/message/priority/tags use materially different JSON schemas.
vector.auth_basis: webhook-URL credentials, Telegram bot-token URL semantics, ntfy bearer/basic headers and SMTP credentials coexist.
vector.config_basis: provider-specific config shapes and secret sets are already explicit.

interpretive_role: These values are moderators fixed before outcomes. They may explain transport survival, reversal or failure; they are not scores and are not altered after treatment results.
